decisions.reason: Persisting help text when a field is empty does not resolve or change the required visual cue for identifying editable fields.
The field may still clear its placeholder on activation while separate help text remains available; the source does not change the clear-on-activation behavior.
The help-text persistence rule does not change the selected editable-text representation or its architecture-quality requirement.
The source does not change the calendar-dropdown selection method for date fields.
The source establishes persistence of help text but does not change its language or any Danish interface wording.
Help-text persistence is unrelated to inclusion of customer theme colors.
The source does not affect table layout or column containment during paste operations.
The source does not affect numbered-list alignment or formatting.
The help-text rule does not change bullet size, balance, alignment, reference design, or color.
The source does not change any named-style font size, weight, family, or caption typography.
Persisting field help text does not change legacy copy-paste layout or style-stability expectations.
The source does not change Tab-based list hierarchy, applicable list styles, or nested-level alignment.
